name: Kana-chan no Kanzen Kyuuketsu Manual
original_name: かなちゃんの完全吸血マニュアル
source:
Vampire girl Kana-chan is less than adult, but more than kid. She lives in the vampire family of four where only mother is actually a human. These are stories about Kana-chan first experiments with sexuality.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
吸血鬼少女小加奈虽不及大人，但又比小孩子更胜一筹。她生活在吸血鬼四口之家，只有母亲实际上是人类。这些是关于小加奈第一次性实验的故事。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
